required.quote: Every dentist, registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, podiatrist, optometrist and dental hygienist practicing in the state shall, on or before July first, nineteen hundred ninety-four and every four years thereafter, complete course work or training appropriate to the professional's practice approved by the department regarding infection control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing the profession fraudulently, beyond its authorized scope, with gross incompetence, with gross negligence on a particular occasion or negligence or incompetence on more than one occasion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession fraudulently, beyond its authorized scope, with gross incompetence, with gross negligence on a particular occasion or negligence or incompetence on more than one occasion,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing the profession while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being habitually drunk or being dependent on, or a habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or other drugs having similar effects
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being habitually drunk or being dependent on, or a habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or other drugs having similar effects,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of committing an act constituting a crime under New York State law, Federal law, or the law of another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of committing an act constituting a crime under: (i) New York State law or, (ii) Federal law or, (iii) The law of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice or professional misconduct by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice or professional misconduct by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state where the conduct upon which the finding was based would, if committed in New York state, constitute professional misconduct under the laws of New York state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found by the commissioner of health to be in violation of article thirty-three of the public health law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found by the commissioner of health to be in violation of article thirty-three of the public health law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice medicine revoked, suspended or other disciplinary action taken in another state for conduct constituting professional misconduct in New York
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having his license to practice medicine revoked, suspended or having other disciplinary action taken, or having his application for a license refused, revoked or suspended or having voluntarily or otherwise surrendered his license after a disciplinary action was instituted by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to provide professional service to a person because of such person's race, creed, color, or national origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to provide professional service to a person because of such person's race, creed, color, or national origin,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing unprofessional conduct as defined by the board of regents in its rules or by the commissioner in regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing unprofessional conduct, as defined by the board of regents in its rules or by the commissioner in regulations approved by the board of regents,

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of section twenty-eight hundred three-d or twenty-eight hundred five-k of the public health law, or section 6505-b (infection control)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of section twenty-eight hundred three-d or twenty-eight hundred five-k of the public health law.

definition_quote.value: The practice of the profession of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined as diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens prescribed by a licensed physician, dentist or other licensed health care provider legally authorized under this title and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of the profession of nursing as a registered professional nurse is defined as diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens prescribed by a licensed physician, dentist or other licensed health care provider legally authorized under this title and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations.

drug_authority.value: Nurse practitioners may issue prescriptions for drugs, devices and immunizing agents in accordance with a practice agreement and practice protocols, upon obtaining a certificate from the department after completing an appropriate pharmacology component.
drug_authority.quote: Prescriptions for drugs, devices and immunizing agents may be issued by a nurse practitioner, under this paragraph and section six thousand nine hundred ten of this article, in accordance with the practice agreement and practice protocols

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: may include the diagnosis of illness and physical conditions and the performance of therapeutic and corrective measures within a specialty area of practice, in collaboration with a licensed physician qualified to collaborate in the specialty involved, provided such services are performed in accordance with a written practice agreement and written practice protocols

full_independent_practice_available.quote: a nurse practitioner, certified under section sixty-nine hundred ten of this article and practicing for more than three thousand six hundred hours shall not be required to comply with the requirements of paragraph (a) of this subdivision relating to collaboration with a physician, a written practice agreement and written practice protocols.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The nurse practitioner shall obtain a certificate from the department upon successfully completing a program including an appropriate pharmacology component, or its equivalent, as established by the commissioner's regulations, prior to prescribing under this paragraph.
